text:
Maria - CSM: Hightide Labs flagging an expansion signal. Their data-science sandbox team spun up a new project and qps doubled overnight. They're asking about a temporary dedicated pool to avoid tail-latency for interactive experiments. dashboard: https://app.redwood.dev/customers/hightide/usage :eyes:
Sam - SE: Can you paste the 48h numbers? which model variants are they hitting?
Maria - CSM: Quick copy from console:
```
48h peak qps: 720
baseline qps: 320
median tokens/req: 700
95th tokens/req: 1600
routes: /chat (65%), /embed (25%), /rerank (10%)
errors: several 429s on /chat at peak
```
Ryan - AE: Renewal in ~6mo. This looks like an upsell opportunity if we make the sandbox feel prod-like. Low-risk pilot + success metrics could convert to Dedicated.
Jen - Infra: Re: 429s — likely hitting route-level concurrency. We can do a short-lived pod bump or add a warm pool. Need expected sustained qps and session length distribution. Any P95 latency numbers?
Maria - CSM: P95 latency during peak ~1.6s for /chat, tail up to 3.8s on some requests. Customer feedback: "interactive notebooks are jittery, can't iterate."
Sam - SE: Model variants? If they're on a larger context model we could suggest a quantized variant for experiments. Which models are used?
Maria - CSM: They're using redwood/gpt-4-compat-32k for most of the runs, with some teams calling redwood/fast-chat-8k.
deploy-bot: quota-request created by Maria for customer=hightide, requested_pool=dedicated-trial-30d, requested_gpus=2
Ryan - AE: Proposed next step: 30-day dedicated pilot (2 GPUs, can burst to 3) + success metrics: sustained qps >=500 with P95 < 1s and <1% 429s. If we hit that, sales will propose commitment.
Jen - Infra: I can stand up a pilot tomorrow night. Need CSM to confirm start window and get security checklist for sandbox -> prod-like network egress.
Maria - CSM: I'll schedule a kickoff with Hightide leads for Tue 10am PT and send the checklist. Also capturing feedback item: they want per-route token billing breakdown in console (they said it helps internal chargebacks).
Sam - SE: I'll prep a short playbook for sandbox experiments: suggested quantization settings, batching config, and caching hints.
Ryan - AE: I'll put a note in CRM: "high expansion intent - sandbox -> dedicated pilot" and tag renewal_touchpoint.
Maria - CSM: Awesome. I'll update the support ticket with pilot params and tag this thread. @Jen - any blocker on infra side?
Jen - Infra: No blockers. I'll provision the trial pool, attach monitoring dashboards, and add an alert for >1% 429s.
Maria - CSM: Great — capturing action items here so we don't lose them:
- Maria: Kickoff Tue 10am PT with Hightide leads
- Jen: Provision 2 GPU trial pool + autoscale to 3 for bursts
- Sam: Playbook + config suggestions before kickoff
- Ryan: CRM update + renewal note
- All: Track success metrics in the shared dashboard

Will post updates after kickoff. :thumbsup:
